boomtang.bio: Boomtang refers to Toronto dance-pop production team The Boomtang Boys, formed by Tony Grace, Paul Grace and Rob DeBoer. The Canadian trio built a major remix catalogue before scoring their own late-1990s hits, including Squeeze Toy, Pictures and Movin’ On, with their work spanning club music, pop and radio dance production.

duck sauce.bio: Duck Sauce is the Canadian-American house duo of Montréal DJ A-Trak and American producer Armand Van Helden. Formed in 2009, the pair fused disco-house hooks with playful club production on records including aNYway and the global hit Barbra Streisand.

kaytraminé.bio: KAYTRAMINÉ is the Canadian-American duo of Montréal-raised producer Kaytranada and Portland rapper Aminé. After years of earlier collaborations, the pair formalized the project for their 2023 self-titled album, blending Kaytranada’s house and funk production with Aminé’s melodic hip-hop and earning a Juno nomination for Rap Album/EP of the Year.

hampton the hampster.bio: Hampton the Hampster is the fictional Canadian novelty-dance act spun out of Deidre LaCarte’s pioneering Hampster Dance website. The musical project was developed with Toronto production team The Boomtang Boys, whose 2000 single The Hampsterdance Song became a Canadian chart-topper before expanding into albums and follow-up singles.
